name: NeXTSTEP
framework: NeXTSTEP 3.x Application Kit / OPENSTEP 4 · Workspace Manager (1989–1997)

elements.name: AlertPanel
elements.doc: An alert panel: title bar, application icon, bold title, message and buttons with the default (return) one on the right

elements.name: AppIcon
elements.doc: A 64 px Dock tile; .variant(.idle) shows the ellipsis of an application that is not running

elements.name: Box
elements.doc: A Box: a grooved frame with its title at the top-left

elements.name: Browser
elements.doc: The column browser: BrowserColumn children, each with its own scroller on the left

elements.name: BrowserCell
elements.doc: A branch cell (folder): title and the right arrow; .selected() highlights it white

elements.name: BrowserColumn
elements.doc: One column of a Browser: BrowserCell (branch, with the arrow) and BrowserLeaf rows

elements.name: BrowserLeaf
elements.doc: A leaf cell (file) without the arrow

elements.name: Button
elements.doc: A bevelled push button; .variant(.default) (or ReturnButton) adds the return glyph; .selected() is the highlighted (white) state

elements.name: ButtonCell
elements.doc: A bevelled push button; .variant(.default) (or ReturnButton) adds the return glyph; .selected() is the highlighted (white) state

elements.name: ButtonRow
elements.doc: A row of buttons along a window's top (Mail, Edit)

elements.name: ColorWell
elements.doc: A colour well: a bevelled frame around a colour swatch

elements.name: DBTableView
elements.doc: A table view: raised column titles over a white grid (Mail's message list)

elements.name: Dock
elements.doc: The Dock: a column of 64 px tiles at the right edge of the screen

elements.name: DockTile
elements.doc: A 64 px Dock tile; .variant(.idle) shows the ellipsis of an application that is not running

elements.name: FileIcon
elements.doc: A Workspace icon: a 48 px picture with its name below; .selected() boxes the name
